body: Founder real-time: 'github upstream created for autocurriculum' -> 'EXODUS' -> 'keep any autocurriculum specific bits there we can prepare for open release.' Probed candidate GitHub repo names (autocurriculum: not found; EXODUS: found, empty) and cloned the real one. Wrote README.md documenting the repo's purpose (a home for REDGARDEN NORTHSTAR §25.4's PFSP opponent-pool autocurriculum research, extracted for eventual public release) with an honest provenance section -- nothing has actually moved here yet, the real working implementation still lives in REDGARDEN (scripts/rl_env_team.py's _sample_opponent/add_opponent_checkpoint, the genuinely game-agnostic half; the C-level sim_step_team_vs_actions/sim_get_obs_team_any plumbing, which is NOT game-agnostic and wouldn't move as-is) -- plus a real, unresolved design-questions section (framework interface, REDGARDEN coupling model, licensing) rather than pretending those are decided. CLAUDE.md follows the monorepo's standard per-repo template. Registered in root CLAUDE.md's Non-Workspace Repos table. EXODUS commit f890dfc, root commit c9c25d8.
title: EXODUS repo scaffolded: CLAUDE.md + README.md for autocurriculum open-release prep
